title_en: Fall 2026 Recognition of Graduate Credits Earned at Other Universities Before Admission
summary: Graduate students who want credits earned at another university's graduate school before admission to be recognized must apply, preferably in their first semester of admission. They must submit all four required documents, including the attached forms (Attachments 02 and 03), to the department office (Building 301, Room 319) by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026. Read Attachment 01 for detailed criteria first; the content of the attachments was not read.
applies_to: Graduate students who wish to have credits recognized that they earned at another university's graduate school before admission to this university. The application is optional, but eligible students are asked to apply in their first semester after admission.

dates.what: Deadline to submit the application documents to the department office (Building 301, Room 319)

conditions: You are asked to apply in your first semester after admission, for smooth academic administration.
All four required documents (items 1 to 4) must be submitted.
Attachment 02 must bear your own signature and your academic advisor's signature (or seal).
On Attachment 03, leave the department head field blank.
For a foreign university, you must submit an English transcript and evidence showing lecture hours (such as a timetable or a breakdown of hours completed).
Only course credits earned in a master's or doctoral program in the same or a similar major at another university, before admission to this university, may be recognized.
Each course must have a grade of B0 or higher, have been completed within the last 10 years, and be the same as or similar to a course here.
Maximum recognized credits: 6 for the master's program, 9 for the doctoral program, and 15 for the integrated master's-doctoral program (see the table in the translation).
If you earned credits in an integrated master's-doctoral program at another university and were admitted to this university's master's program, up to 6 credits may be recognized.
Undergraduate courses cannot be applied for.
Recognition requires the academic advisor's recommendation, review by the department academic committee and the college academic committee, and the President's approval.
Approved courses are recorded on your academic record as completion of the same or similar course here, but their grades are not included in your grade point average.
Once credits are recognized, you may not take the same or a similar course again at this university.
steps: Read Attachment 01 (detailed criteria and curriculum explanation) attached to the original notice; its content was not read for this translation.
Download and complete Attachment 02 (credit recognition application form), sign it yourself, and obtain your academic advisor's signature or seal.
Download and complete Attachment 03 (credit recognition table), leaving the department head field blank.
Obtain the transcript from your previous university; for a foreign university, obtain an English transcript and evidence of lecture hours (such as a timetable or a breakdown of hours completed).
Prepare documents showing the major is the same: course syllabi and major and course overviews (key parts only).
Obtain proof of enrollment at your previous university, such as a certificate of completion or a certificate of enrollment record.
Submit all four documents to the staff member in the department office (Building 301, Room 319) by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026.
translation:
Fall 2026 Application for Recognition of Credits Earned at Another University's Graduate School Before Admission

1. Eligible applicants
Graduate students who wish to have credits recognized that they earned at another university's graduate school before admission to this university.
※ For smooth academic administration, please apply in your first semester after admission.
※ For details, refer to the attachment (Attachment 01).

2. Submission of application documents
A. Period: until 5:00 p.m., Monday, 21 September 2026
B. Submit the application documents to the staff member in the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
C. Application documents: submit all of documents 1) to 4)
1) The attachments (Attachment 02 and Attachment 03)
※ Attachment 02: your own signature and your academic advisor's signature (or seal) are required.
※ Attachment 03: leave the department head field blank.
2) Transcript from your previous university
※ For a foreign university: (1) an English transcript and (2) supporting documents showing lecture hours (timetable, breakdown of hours completed, etc.)
3) Documents confirming that the major is the same: course syllabi, major overview and course overviews (submit key parts only)
4) Proof of affiliation with your previous university: certificate of completion, certificate of enrollment record, etc.

3. Recognition of earned credits
A. Course credits earned in a master's or doctoral program of the same level in the same or a similar major at another university, before admission to this university's master's or doctoral program, may be recognized as completed credits, limited to the same or similar courses completed within 10 years with a grade of B0 or higher, up to 6 credits for the master's program, 9 credits for the doctoral program and 15 credits for the integrated master's-doctoral program.
※ Undergraduate courses: cannot be applied for.
B. However, if you earned credits in an integrated master's-doctoral program at another university before admission and were admitted to this university's master's program, up to 6 credits may be recognized.

Program before admission | Program at this university | Recognized credits
Master's | Master's | Up to 6 credits
Master's | Integrated master's-doctoral | Up to 6 credits
Doctoral | Doctoral | Up to 9 credits
Doctoral | Integrated master's-doctoral | Up to 9 credits
Integrated master's-doctoral | Master's | Up to 6 credits
Integrated master's-doctoral | Integrated master's-doctoral | Up to 15 credits

C. Credit recognition procedure
1) Academic advisor's recommendation → department academic committee → college academic committee → approval by the President.
2) Courses approved for credit recognition are recorded on the academic record as completion of the same or similar course at this university, but their grades are not included in the calculation of the grade point average.
D. If you have received 'recognition of credits from another university's graduate school', you may not take the same or a similar course again at this university.

- Refer to the attachments.
- Inquiries: department office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff contact details are given in the original notice.
